source_caption:
The Covenant — A Promise Worth Fighting For

Guy Ritchie’s The Covenant (2023) follows Sergeant John Kinley, a U.S. Army soldier whose mission in Afghanistan takes a devastating turn when his unit is ambushed. During the attack, local interpreter Ahmed risks everything to protect Kinley and help him survive.

After returning home, Kinley learns that Ahmed and his family are still trapped in Afghanistan, despite the promises made to those who assisted the soldiers. Unable to forget the debt he owes Ahmed, Kinley decides to return and bring him to safety.

What begins as a personal mission quickly becomes a dangerous journey through enemy territory. Kinley must face the same kind of dangers he thought he had left behind while searching for the man who once saved his life.

The film explores themes of loyalty, sacrifice, friendship, courage, and the responsibility that comes with giving someone your word. At its heart, the story focuses on two men whose lives become connected through trust and survival.

What makes The Covenant compelling is the emotional weight behind the action. Kinley isn't simply completing another mission—he is risking everything because he refuses to abandon someone who risked everything for him.

💬 He saved his life once. Now Kinley will risk everything to save his.

source_details.synopsis: Guy Ritchie's The Covenant (or simply The Covenant) is a 2023 American action drama film produced and directed by Guy Ritchie and co-written with Marn Davies and Ivan Atkinson. The film stars Jake Gyllenhaal and Dar Salim. Its plot follows John Kinley, a U.S. Army Green Beret Master Sergeant sent home after surviving a Taliban ambush and a harrowing trek to safety, and his subsequent journey to rescue Ahmed, his Afghan interpreter, whom John feels indebted to for saving his life. The film was theatrically released by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer and STXfilms in the United States on April 21, 2023, received generally positive reviews from critics and grossed $21 million.
